character_facts: The woman on the left is aware of the invasion through some kind of display or observation method.
She expects to be called upon for aid and is surprised that no such call was made.
characters_present: A female observer/narrator shown in profile at the left, apparently monitoring events
continuity_links: This page depicts a larger ongoing invasion involving mirror or reflected forces.
The destruction is presented as something being watched remotely rather than experienced directly by the speaker.
dialogue_meaning: The speaker is confused and frustrated that an invasion of their universe is happening without anyone summoning her help.
Narration explains that the imperial fleet encountered a reflected duplicate of itself and was destroyed by it.
Narration states that the mirror-ships went on to destroy the system's only planet.
locations: Orbit or near-space around the system's only planet
lore_facts: There is an 'imperial fleet' active in this setting.
A phenomenon described as a reflection or mirror version of ships can physically confront and destroy the originals.
The Vurfni-Be system has only one planet.
The invading force is framed as entering or affecting 'our universe.'
plot_events: A female observer comments that something is invading their universe and that no call for her aid has come.
An imperial fleet confronts a reflected or mirror version of itself.
The mirrored ships annihilate the opposing fleet in a massive space battle.
The only planet in the Vurfni-Be system is destroyed.
uncertainties: Some caption and speech text is small and partially hard to read, so wording may be approximate.
The identity and name of the female observer are not given on this page.
The exact nature of the 'reflection' or 'mirror-ships' is not explained beyond the narration's wording.
visual_summary: A two-page space-battle spread shows a woman in profile at the left watching destruction in space. Large silver, disc-like ships exchange or emit massive beams of light while red ships and other craft are torn apart around them. In the lower half, explosions engulf a planet or large spherical body as narration states the mirrored ships destroy the only planet in the system.
